title: REQ · Sound and settings flags with actions in the UI store
summary: useUiStore exposes soundEnabled and settingsOpen flags with toggle actions.
description: Context: header needs sound toggle and settings. Desired behavior: store holds soundEnabled (default true) and settingsOpen (default false) with toggleSound, setSoundEnabled and toggleSettings. Expected result: flags change via actions. Why: header sound toggle and settings need shared state.
acceptance_criteria: Given a fresh store, When read, Then soundEnabled is true and settingsOpen is false
Given a fresh store, When toggleSound is called, Then soundEnabled is false
Given a fresh store, When toggleSettings is called, Then settingsOpen is true
